title: capture_effect_frames specification
description: Observe an existing Niagara system: build a transient editor-world stage, step simulation ages, export PNG frames under Saved/UEREMCP/VfxCapture/<asset>/<request-id>/, reread each file, and report baseline pixel deltas. Does not author, modify, save, or compile the target asset. Requires a functioning editor renderer/RHI (not headless NullRHI). Cold editor sessions may export valid PNGs with zero changed pixels (status failed_validation); retry after an editor tick / warm capture. Owned by WS-11; catalog/schema registration WS-01.

frame_count.description: Number of age-stepped frames to capture after the empty-stage baseline.

duration_seconds.description: Simulation span in seconds across which frame ages are distributed.
